functions.name: QTY
functions.description: Quantity of a DWFx Measure dimension group (or of one of its dimensions). Updates live when the measurement changes.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group reference (the first 8 characters of the group id).

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Optional: empty for the total, "Count", "Base" or "Length".

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Optional: dimension reference, or a model object id.

functions.name: VALUE
functions.description: Quantity of one dimension of a DWFx Measure dimension group.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Dimension reference, or a model object id.

functions.name: NAME
functions.description: Name of a DWFx Measure dimension group.

functions.name: UNIT
functions.description: Unit of a DWFx Measure dimension group (m, m2, m3, nr).
